capabilities: Search YES24 by title, author or ISBN
Pick an edition from paginated results
Insert publication details into the open note
Preserve personal reading properties and text outside the generated section
extras: Relies on YES24's unofficial endpoints and page structure, which the README warns can change; it points to separate research and verification notes for current assumptions and test scope.
problem: Publication details for a book have to be copied by hand from a bookstore page into a note.

relations.evidence: The plugin sends search terms to YES24.

summary: Searches YES24 for Korean and foreign books by title, author or ISBN and writes publication details into the open note.
